title: Walk-by storefront — corridor view
best_use: Show people passing storefronts, entering and exiting, and spatial occupancy changes.
caveat: Acted research footage. Corridor is not a grocery checkout; do not claim purchases or conversion.

title: Store assistant interaction — front view
scene: Customer stops and interacts near a storefront
best_use: Explain observed dwell and how browsing differs from congestion.
caveat: Acted retail research footage; interactions are not purchases. Do not infer shopper intent from motion alone.

title: Store entrance — two couples
best_use: Demonstrate entrance-area grouping, short tracks and occlusion.
caveat: Camera-local temporary tracks are not reliable store-wide unique visitor counts.

title: Busy corridor — shopping/waiting scene
scene: Several people crossing a shopping-centre corridor
best_use: Compare changing zone occupancy during dense group movement.
caveat: Busy groups can fragment tracks; inferred dwell is partial, not a validated queue length.

title: Store entry — paired views alternative
scene: Store entry viewed from the front
best_use: Demonstrate camera-angle sensitivity and local entrance zones.
caveat: Do not assume synchronization with other views without verifying timecodes.

title: Shopping mall — crowded overhead webcam
best_use: Show crowd-density stress and undercounting risks; use as an honesty/limitations demo.
caveat: Frames are sampled below 2 Hz, exported at nominal 2 FPS. Head-point ground truth is NOT directly comparable to our full-person box counts. Dwell, speed and event timing are NOT validated.
license: Research only / no commercial use (CUHK Mall Dataset)

title: Shelf browsing — fixed overhead retail view
scene: Single shopper near grocery shelves in an overhead lab video
best_use: Show stationary browsing, unusual camera angle and challenging person detections.
caveat: Single actor filmed in a lab store. Shelf-action labels do not train or validate Everseen's person detector; non-commercial research only.

title: Teammate's store footage — multi-person
best_use: Show realistic customer movement with better video resolution than CAVIAR.
caveat: Available only when the teammate checkout is present; redistribution/use permissions must be confirmed with the teammate. Not ground-truth labelled for our metrics.

title: Convenience store — multi-aisle wide shot
scene: Wide store interior with shelves and a walkable main aisle
best_use: Show ordinary aisle traffic and how occupancy changes as shoppers pass through a zone.
caveat: 360p. Overlapping shoppers under-count; boxes occasionally land on shelving. No ground truth, so no accuracy claim.
license: User-supplied CCTV clip · provenance and redistribution rights not verified · local demo use only

title: Mall atrium — upper level walkway
scene: Two-level mall atrium with an upper walkway and a busy atrium floor
best_use: Crowded-scene stress test: sustained high occupancy and dense track churn.
caveat: Crowded and low-resolution, so under-counting is expected; occasional false positives on benches and fixtures. Illustrates limits, not validated accuracy.
license: User-supplied CCTV clip · provenance and redistribution rights not verified · local demo use only

title: Pharmacy counter — queue area
scene: Steep overhead view of a pharmacy counter with people standing at the service area
best_use: Explain observed dwell at a service counter while explicitly avoiding any checkout-wait or transaction claim.
caveat: Very little visible floor and heavy occlusion at this angle; counts are indicative only. Not a checkout-wait measurement.
license: User-supplied CCTV clip · provenance and redistribution rights not verified · local demo use only

title: Convenience store — counter front
scene: Small store with a central counter and a front door
best_use: Sparse-traffic control case: show how the same metrics behave in a quiet scene.
caveat: Very few people in the clip. Low counts here are a property of the footage, not a detection failure.
license: User-supplied CCTV clip · provenance and redistribution rights not verified · local demo use only

title: Liquor aisle — narrow walkways
scene: Narrow aisle between shelving and a central display rack
best_use: Demonstrate zone placement in a constrained aisle, and why narrow zones fragment tracks.
caveat: Single-shopper scene with heavy occlusion by the centre rack. Track counts will fragment when someone passes behind it.
license: User-supplied CCTV clip · provenance and redistribution rights not verified · local demo use only

title: Produce corner — aisle
scene: Wide produce aisle with shelving on both sides
best_use: Second sparse case, and a contrast against the crowded mall clip.
caveat: Low 6 fps source and small subjects; slow-moving shoppers may be missed between samples.
